title: Program and Administrative Associate
description:
About the job

The Program and Administrative Associate supports smooth office and program operations by overseeing the reception, answering calls, providing administrative, logistical, and travel support, managing communications, inventory, and office facilities, and program-related activities. The role ensures compliance with FHI 360 policies while facilitating efficient implementation of projects and events.

Key Responsibilities


Manage the reception function, greeting visitors, answering calls, and directing inquiries appropriately. 
Oversee office communications, including telephone, fax, and mail (incoming/outgoing), maintaining logs as per office procedures. 
Prepare Procurement Requisitions and Purchase Orders to obtain necessary signatures and approvals ensuring adherence to FHI 360 Nepal procurement policy. 
Process Expense Authorizations (EA) for staff and visitors, arrange travel (hotels, airline tickets, vehicle rentals), and maintain travel records in accordance with FHI 360 travel policy. 
Support logistics and administrative arrangements for internal and external meetings, workshops, trainings, and events, including liaising with external organizations and FHI 360 staff. 
Maintain and update project and office inventories, including preparation of donor-required reports. 
Prepare duty rosters and coordinate driver and security assignments for normal and off hours as required. 
Liaise with external organizations to arrange meetings, workshops and other events as appropriate. 
Provide ongoing support for office building operations, including electricity, water, communications, and maintenance of equipment and furniture. 
Maintain accurate logs, matrices, and reports related to travel, events, proposals, and project activities. 
Perform other administrative, logistics, or project support duties as assigned Supervisor and Country Representative. 


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in business administration or social sciences or any relevant field with one year of relevant work experience or Intermediate degree with three to five years of relevant work experience. 
Experience in planning, coordination, communication, and collaboration with multiple teams, scheduling, and executing office- and program-related activities and events. 
Experience in working effectively across various teams within the project and organization, and building and sustaining positive working relationships with NGOs, private sectors, government and other stakeholders. 
Ability to manage office operations, including reception, calls, mail, and general administrative support, ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning. 
Experience in coordinating travel, logistics, and event arrangements, including workshops, meetings, and training. 
Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records, track data, and assist in reporting for program and administrative activities. 
Proactive in managing multiple tasks, managing and working in the virtual work environment, and flexible and open to managing time working with different teams in different time zones as needed. 
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, communication, coordination and collaboration, team building and management, and problem-solving skills. 
Experience using Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, etc.) an advantage. 
Excellent oral and written English and Nepali including documentation skills.

title: Work from home| Recording Assistant | non experience required
description:
About the job

Job Description

Job Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (Freelance)

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

Pay: $6 per hour (Fixed hourly rate)




Job Summary

We are looking for experts to record short videos of everyday home activities.

These videos will be used to help robotics learn how people do normal tasks at home. You will record yourself doing things you already do in your daily life, such as cleaning, laundry, or cooking.




What You Will Do

Record videos of normal daily home activities
Examples include:
Washing dishes (by hand or dishwasher)
Doing laundry
Folding clothes
Sweeping or mopping floors
Making food or coffee etc
Wear a phone on a headband so your hands are free
Follow simple instructions for how to record
Keep the recording area clean and well lit




What You Need

A smartphone with a wide camera (0.5 zoom)
A headband to hold the phone while recording
A clean and tidy space in your home
Good lighting (natural or indoor light is fine)
Internet connection to upload videos




Important Notes

You do not need acting skills
You do not need to talk during the videos unless asked
You do not need to show your face in the videos
You just do the tasks the normally

Who Can Apply

Anyone who can do basic home tasks
No degree or special skills required
Suitable for people of all backgrounds




Why This Job Matters

Your videos will help improve future technology by showing how real people move and work at home. Every recording helps make robotics technology better and more accurate.

title: Online Order Support VA

As a Brand Concierge, you will help customers complete purchases, recover subscriptions or abandoned carts, and create a premium shopping experience that keeps customers coming back.

If you are passionate about sales, thrive in e-commerce environments, and enjoy turning customer interactions into revenue and long-term brand loyalty, this role is for you.

To ensure your application is reviewed by the **Recruitment Team**, you must follow these critical steps exactly. **Applications that do not choose 'Brand Concierge' and enter the correct code WILL NOT be reviewed.**

Strong persuasive communication skills and a natural ability to convert leads and close opportunities through excellent relationship-building.

Familiarity with Shopify, CRM tools, or customer engagement platforms is a plus.
Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced remote environment.


Technical Requirements


A personal PC or laptop with an i5 processor or higher.
A stable internet connection with at least 15 Mbps upload and download speeds.
A quiet, professional workspace suitable for calls.

Earn commissions and annual performance-based raises.
Paid time off to relax and recharge.
HMO health coverage or a monthly health stipend.
Performance and recognition bonuses for top achievers.
100% permanent work-from-home setup.
A supportive, friendly team culture and real opportunities for growth.


Ready to represent top e-commerce brands and help customers complete their online shopping journey? Apply now to become a Brand Concierge - E-commerce Sales & Order Support VA at TalentPop App!

Job Description

Background

While climate change is observed across Nepal, the rate of temperature increase is more pronounced at higher altitudes. This temperature rise accelerates the rate of glacial retreat, increasing the size of glacial lakes located in these high-altitude areas and, in turn, their likelihood of breaching in the form of Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF) which cause severe flooding, landslides and mudflows that damage infrastructure and private assets, and disrupt transportation networks, agricultural production, power supplies from hydropower plants and tourism activities. Damages from GLOFs are often irreparable for decades, with considerable economic costs, particularly to downstream populations. The risk of GLOFs is further exacerbated by increasing temperatures which increase the rate of snow and ice melt and the proportion of precipitation falling as rain, which increases the volume of the lakes, thereby reducing the amount of ‘freeboard’, which increases the likelihood of overflow and the intensity of resulting floods.

The Thulagi, Lower Barun, Lumding Tsho and Hongu 2 Lakes are at exceptionally high risk of breaching having already exhibited considerable increases in volume, accelerated degradation of their ice-cored moraines, and a reduced amount of ‘freeboard’ as a result of climate change. Combined, these factors have destabilized the lakes, exposing the Gandaki Basin and the Dudhkoshi and Arun Sub-basins to the threat of a GLOF event. Without intervention, these glacial lakes could breach at any given moment, adversely impacting vulnerable Nepalese communities.

In response to this risk, USD36 millions of GCF funds, alongside USD14 million in cofinance, will be directed to reduce the risk and impacts of GLOFs at the four priority glacial lakes by shifting towards a proactive approach to GLOF risk reduction in Nepal. The proposed project presents an integrated approach to GLOF risk management in Nepal by addressing institutional and technical capacities, physical protection (both grey and green infrastructure approaches), hazard monitoring and early warning. This integrated approach will utilise GCF funds to: i) lower the water levels of four glacial lakes to reduce their risk of breaching; ii) implement Eco-Disaster Risk Reduction interventions in mountain ecosystems to mitigate the residual flood impacts from a GLOF; iii) establish and implement early warning systems to alleviate damages and prevent the loss of lives from GLOFs; and iv) strengthen the technical and institutional capacity of Nepal’s Department of Hydrology and Meteorology to plan for and respond to GLOFs and floods. These interventions will catalyse a shift from a need- and project-based approach towards proactive and pre-emptive approaches, engendered through strengthened capacity among institutions and communities.

The project will be implemented following UNDP’s support to National Implementation Modality (NIM), with Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM) under Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation (MoEWRI) of Nepal serving as the Implementing Partner. Under this modality, UNDP is supporting DHM in recruiting key positions for the establishment of a Project Management Unit, which will be based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Members of the PMU will collectively be responsible for overall planning and budgeting, collaborating with other ministries, sectors and government entities to implement the project performance management system; bidding for the provision of project consultancy services; coordination with the responsible parties in terms of bidding of goods and services; disbursement and implementation of project audits, operation of accounts, monitoring and preparation of overall project reports (annual), and safeguards policy monitoring reports.

Duties And Responsibilities

The PMU will be headed by the Project Coordination Specialist (PCS). The PCS will report directly to the Chief Technical Advisor and work on day-to-day basis with Portfolio Manager (Resilience and Environment) and Programme Analyst (Climate Change and Resilience). The PMU will operate under the overall guidance of the National Project Director (NPD) — as assigned by MoEWRI.

The Project Coordination Specialist (PCS) will lead the project management unit and oversee day-to-day implementation under the guidance of the Project Board (PB) for Nepal. The PCS will be responsible for ensuring that project results are delivered in line with the approved project document, meeting agreed standards of quality, timeframes, and budget. Key duties include preparing annual work plans and budgets for Board approval, as well as quarterly and annual progress reports outlining achievements, challenges, and necessary adjustments. The PCS will manage procurement and recruitment of national and international service providers and specialist expertise in consultation with the Board. Given that the project is implemented in partnership with the Government of Nepal and various stakeholders, the PCS will also play a central role in coordinating the efforts of all partners to ensure coherent and effective delivery. This role requires someone who can understand existing codebases, build end-to-end features across .NET, React, and AI driven automation, and improve reliability where it matters.

• Connect internal systems with databases, authentication flows (OAuth/RBAC), and third-party services.

AI, Automation, and Intelligent Systems

• Actively use Cursor AI, GitHub Copilot, and similar AI tools for:

 o Code generation

• Debug production issues in Power Apps, backend services, integrations, or AI workflows. 

• Implement observability using Azure Monitor and Application Insights. 

• Ensure AI-generated code meets production-grade standards. 




Product Thinking & Problem Solving 

• Be product-oriented, not just task-oriented. 

• Understand business problems and convert them into technical solutions. 

• Make sound trade-offs between speed, quality, scalability, and maintainability. 

• Proactively identify product gaps and improvement opportunities. 

• Work comfortably in high-pressure environments with tight timelines. 




Collaborate & Take Ownership 

• Work independently on complex features while owning them end-to-end. 

• Collaborate with stakeholders, managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to scope MVPs. 

• Proactively propose improvements across: 

 o Automation workflows 

 o System design 

 o Integrations 

 o User experience 

• Review AI-written and human-written code for quality and correctness. 

• Document processes, AI prompts, codebases, and technical decisions clearly. 




Impact You’ll Have in Your First 30–60 Days 

• Ship at least one end-to-end user-facing feature across Power Platform or full stack systems. 

• Close production bugs and reduce support load through automation improvements. 

• Enhance a critical internal system (automation, performance, reliability, or AI workflow). 

• Add missing observability and automate 1–2 repetitive internal processes. 




What We’re Looking For 

Must-Haves 

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. 

• 4+ years of experience in full-stack development. 

• Strong proficiency in React and .NET Core/MVC. 

• Strong understanding of AI concepts and practical automation use cases. 

• Hands-on experience with Cursor AI (mandatory) or similar AI coding tools. 

• Ability to understand, debug, and improve AI-generated code. 

• Experience with REST APIs, GraphQL, backend integrations, and microservices. 

• Strong database skills in SQL Server or PostgreSQL. 

• Familiarity with Azure cloud, authentication/security (OAuth/RBAC), and DevOps practices. 

• Strong problem-solving ability and product mindset. 

• Ability to work under pressure and deliver reliably. 

• Ability to learn new tools and frameworks quickly and own complex projects independently. 




Nice-to-Haves 

• Experience with Power Apps (Canvas / Model-Driven). 

• Realtime/WebSocket experience (streaming responses, realtime UI). 

• Performance tuning and cost optimization for AI/ML workloads. 

• Experience with feature flags, experimentation, analytics pipelines, and observability tools. 

• Strong customer-centric mindset and feedback-driven development approach. 




Our Tech Stack 

• Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind 

• Backend: .NET Core/MVC, REST/GraphQL

 • Tools: Notion, Miro (or equivalent) 




Why Join?

ACCOUNTABILITY

● Own tests cover all the acceptance criteria and are composed properly as per QA

standards and policies.

● Maintain our test automation framework and processes tailored to the specific product’s needs.

conducting manual testing.

improvements.

Bodgaun Primary Health Centre (Bodgaun Medical Centre), now under the dynamic management of Jay Nepal NGO, an Italo-Nepalese humanitarian force, is embarking on an exciting revitalization phase. Originally established in 2018, we're taking the reins to relaunch and elevate this vital facility for Indrawati Rural Municipality and surrounding Sindhupalchok communities in Bagmati Province. Ongoing professional growth via specialized workshops, simulations, and certifications (e.g., ASBA for surgical skills)

Collaborative exchanges with global experts in general practice and emergency care

Pathways to international exposure, research opportunities, and career advancement




Why Join Us?

As our MDGP Doctor, you'll lead the charge in creating excellence in rural healthcare, realizing your dreams of innovative, community-centered medicine. Collaborate with us to design efficient operational flows, shape the entire clinical team with your ideas, and align it all with Jay Nepal's vision of accessible, high-quality care. This is your opportunity to build a legacy in Sindhupalchok, supported by international partnerships and a fresh start for the centre.

If you're an MDGP doctor passionate about community-driven medicine, this is your chance to shine! In rural Nepal, where timely interventions like C-sections or hernia repairs save lives and build lasting trust, your broad expertise can make all the difference. Join a supportive team, enjoy a balanced rural lifestyle, and leverage our global network to elevate your practice. With competitive compensation and meaningful impact, why settle for urban hustle when you can pioneer change here? Apply now and be the vital link in raising hope for these communities!

MDGP Doctor (with Focus on Basic Surgical Procedures in Rural Primary Care)

(Preference for candidates with additional surgical training like ASBA; MS/MD in Surgery also welcome for enhanced roles)

MBBS from a recognized institution, followed by 3-year MD in General Practice and Emergency Medicine (MDGP) approved by the Nepal Medical Council (NMC)

Valid NMC registration and specialist license

At least 3 years of post-MDGP experience in general practice, emergency care, or rural health settings (candidates with 2 years and strong procedural skills will be considered)

Proficiency in basic surgical procedures (e.g., via ASBA or equivalent training) and post-operative management in resource-limited environments

Basic computer literacy for electronic health records (EHR) and Health Management Information System (HMIS) reporting




🕘 Working Arrangements




OPD and OT hours: 09:00 – 17:00, with scheduling flexibility for procedures

Lead clinical and surgical services in Outpatient Department (OPD), Operating Theatre (OT), and emergency response

On-call roster for 24/7 emergencies, supported by paramedic team

Adherence to NMC ethical guidelines, hospital SOPs, and Nepal's health sector standards (e.g., infection prevention and control - IPC)




💰 Salary & Benefits




Competitive salary commensurate with qualifications, experience, and skills (negotiable)

Free accommodation provided at Bodgaun Primary Health Centre (with family options available)

Meals, transportation, and personal expenses to be managed by the employee

Additional incentives: Performance bonuses, rural hardship allowances, sponsored international training (e.g., Italy exchanges), and relocation support for you and your family

Deliver comprehensive primary care, including pre-operative assessments, basic surgeries, and post-operative follow-up in a non-ICU rural setup

Perform essential procedures, including:

- Cesarean Section (C-Section)

- Appendectomy

- Hernia Repair (e.g., Inguinal or Umbilical)

- Exploratory Laparotomy

- Abscess Incision and Drainage (I&D)

- Fracture Management (Open Reduction Internal Fixation - ORIF or External Fixation)

- Tendon/Ligament Repair (Basic Suturing)

- Wound Debridement and Suturing

- Excision of Benign Lumps (e.g., Lipomas)

- Hydrocele Repair




Collaborate with the health assistants, paramedical team, anesthetist and lab technicians for integrated patient care; mentor junior staff and contribute to team development

Maintain accurate records, manage inventory for clinical and surgical supplies, and ensure compliance with IPC protocols

Participate in community outreach, health camps, home visits for follow-up, and HMIS data entry

Engage in quality improvement initiatives, team meetings, and international case discussions

Email: mail2jaynepal@gmail.com

Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) highlighting clinical and surgical experience

Copy of Nepali Citizenship Certificate

Letter of Interest (explaining your vision for rural healthcare leadership)

Academic transcripts, MBBS, and MDGP certificates

NMC registration and specialist license

Reference letters or contacts (if available)

title: Purchase Officer
description:
About the job

Overview

The Procurement Officer is responsible for end-to-end procurement and import operations. The role focuses on commodity sourcing, vendor management, import coordination, rate analysis, freight negotiation, LC management, and reporting. The position works closely with the Director and AGM and ensures cost-effective purchasing, timely imports, and accurate documentation.

Job Description


Updating the rates of the commodities which are buying on daily basis.
Asking for and updating the rates of other edible goods from various parties.Finding new vendors / new products.
Preparation of Import chart (LC wise) and updating the same on weekly basis and providing the hard copy to the director every Friday. 
Preparation of rate comparison chart list on daily basis from various suppliers and reporting to the director.
Preparation of ocean freight rate excel sheet on monthly basis and reporting and sending the rate comparison sheet to the director.
Negotiation of ocean freight rates with our Clearing and Forwarding Agent in Kolkata for every shipment. Minute negotiation needed for negotiating the Ocean freight because the Ocean freight suppliers have a tendancy to quote higher ocean freight by 10%. 
Correspondence with our Clearing and Forwarding Agent via email, call and what’s app message regarding the shipment status, ocean freight finalization and delivery of invoices.
Preparation of Letter of Authorization to our clearing and Forwarding agent in Kolkata for every consignment.
Preparations of container chart of each and every consignment and send the same to our warehouse.
Checking Proforma Invoice and Sales Contract of our deals thoroughly before LC transmission.
Update and prepare comparison sheet of crude oil and other commodities prices from the LC list issued by the Consulate General of Nepal to Kolkata twice a week and reporting to the director.
Price update of Zinc on daily basis & report to the Director on daily basis.
Correspondence with parties for shipping documents, artwork, label, Bill of Lading and other required documents for food permit preparation.
Preparation and updating of LC wise chart once a week and Insurance claim sheet and debit note against weight shortage.
Preparation of import plan of our commodities for future purchases and sharing the same with the director.
Keep an update on dollar rate on daily basis for forward booking. Dollar booking job is also responsibility of candidate.
All other claims & correspondence related to FOSFA Discount, OTR Shortage, Claims, Survey e.t.c will have to be done & overlooked by the procurement officer. 
Monthly analysis of commodity goods, landing price & proper analysis to be done in terms of expected buying price & daily sales prices. 
Preparation of Sales Order in the absence of concerned staff.
Any other work/responsibility regarding purchase, negotiation shall fall under responsibility of candidate. 
All procurement work shall be the sole responsibility of Procurement Officer which shall be done under the guidance of Director & AGM.


Job Specification


Experience in edible oil or commodity trading industry 
Knowledge of Nepal–India import regulations 
Ability to handle multiple consignments simultaneously 
Strong coordination skills with logistics partners 
3years of experience in procurement, imports, or commodity trading 
Hands-on experience with: LC documentation and import coordination 
Experience dealing with Clearing & Forwarding agents, preferably Kolkata route.


Skills: freight,reporting,procurement,negotiation

title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

Join Our Team at TalentPop App as an Influencer Marketing Specialist!

At TalentPop App, we're on a mission to transform the digital landscape through impactful influencer partnerships. We're looking for an innovative and strategic Influencer Marketing Specialist with strong marketing experience to help shape the future of e-commerce. If you're passionate about influencer marketing, skilled in executing high-impact campaigns, and eager to make a real impact, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Why You'll Love This Role

You’ll be at the forefront of developing and executing marketing strategies that leverage influencers to build brand awareness, drive engagement, and boost conversions. As part of our team, your creativity, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach will directly contribute to our growth and success.

What You'll Do


Develop Strategies: Create influencer marketing plans that align with overall marketing objectives, brand goals, and measurable KPIs.
Source Talent: Identify and engage influencers who resonate with our brand, target audience, and campaign goals.
Build Partnerships: Cultivate and maintain strong, professional relationships with influencers, agencies, and brand partners.
Oversee Campaigns: Manage campaign timelines, content creation, and deliverables in collaboration with influencers and the marketing team.
Ensure Quality: Provide creative direction and review influencer content to ensure it aligns with brand identity and campaign messaging.
Analyze & Report: Use analytics tools to measure performance, generate reports, and optimize future marketing initiatives.
Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with social media, content, and paid marketing teams to ensure campaigns integrate seamlessly into broader marketing efforts.


What We're Looking For


At least 1 year of proven experience in influencer marketing, with a solid background in broader marketing campaigns.
Exceptional relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills.
In-depth understanding of social media platforms, influencer trends, digital marketing strategies, and audience engagement tactics.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
A creative and passionate mindset for digital marketing, brand storytelling, and campaign innovation.


Tech Requirements


Personally owned PC or laptop with sufficient processing power.
Reliable internet connection with a minimum of 15 Mbps for both upload and download speed.


Perks And Benefits


Permanent remote work setup, giving you the flexibility to work from anywhere.
HMO coverage or a health stipend to support your health and well-being.
Performance bonuses to reward your hard work and success.
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) to rest and recharge.
Opportunities for professional growth and development within a dynamic and supportive environment at TalentPop App.


Special Instruction

For us to prioritize your application for the Influencer Marketing Specialist role, please enter code INFL25 when asked.

At TalentPop App, we’re not just hiring; we’re building a team of passionate, innovative individuals who will drive the future of e-commerce. If you’re ready to make a real impact and take your marketing career to the next level, apply now!

title: Social Media Content Creator
description:
About the job

Bring Your Ideas to Life as a Social Media Content Creator at TalentPop App

Are you a creative storyteller who thrives on crafting engaging content for online audiences? At TalentPop App, we’re looking for a Social Media Content Creator who can design graphics and edit short-form videos that stop the scroll and spark meaningful engagement. This is your chance to turn ideas into impact—from anywhere in the world.

What You'll Be Doing


Create captivating social media content, including graphics, Reels, TikToks, carousels, stories, and short-form videos, tailored for platforms like Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and more.
Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to bring campaigns and brand messaging to life.
Edit videos for both organic and paid social campaigns, adding captions, overlays, transitions, and music aligned with brand standards.
Write snappy captions, compelling hooks, and calls-to-action that convert viewers into fans and customers.
Monitor social trends and adapt content to maximize reach, relevance, and engagement.

Proficiency with Canva, Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects), CapCut, or similar tools.
Understanding of audience psychology, platform algorithms, and social ad best practices.
Creative energy, attention to detail, and a collaborative spirit.

Reliable DSL, Cable, or Fiber internet (minimum 15 Mbps upload/download).

100% remote work—build your career from anywhere.

title: Senior AI Engineer (India)
description:
About the job

Job Title: Senior AI Engineer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Hybrid (Bangalore, Pune, NCR)

Experience: 4-6+ Years of Relevant Experience




Job Summary:

Join our team as a Senior AI Engineer and play a pivotal role in designing, building, and optimizing next-generation Generative AI applications. You will leverage your expertise in Large Language Models, state-of-the-art AI platforms, and cloud technologies to deliver scalable, production-grade AI solutions. We value clear, impactful written and verbal communication as much as deep technical skill.




Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture and implementation of GenAI systems — including RAG, multi-agent workflows, and autonomous reasoning frameworks.
Architect and optimize complex data ingestion, embedding, and retrieval pipelines using vector databases.
Build scalable, low-latency APIs and integrate LLM capabilities into production-grade platforms.
Evaluate and select appropriate frameworks and tools (e.g., Neo4j vs. Neptune for graph data) based on project needs.
Mentor junior engineers and drive best practices in system design and deployment.
Oversee deployment architectures on AWS or Azure, ensuring reliability and cost efficiency.
Innovate in emerging GenAI areas — multi-agent coordination, MCP, and agent-to-agent communication (A2A).
Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to align technical roadmaps with strategic goals.




Must-have Skills:

Python: Expert. Strong design, debugging, and optimization capabilities.
API Development: Advanced knowledge of FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.
GenAI Stack: LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and hands-on with multiple LLMs.
RAG Expertise: End-to-end lifecycle mastery — from data processing to deployment.
Architectural Thinking: Tool comparison, scalability, fault tolerance, performance trade-offs.
Cloud/DevOps: Deep hands-on experience with AWS or Azure (infrastructure, monitoring, CI/CD).




Good-to-have Skills:

Emerging Tech: MCP, A2A agents, advanced orchestration frameworks.
Responsible AI: Experience applying governance and safety frameworks.
Leadership: Mentorship, technical roadmap ownership, code review.
Cross-System Integration: Familiarity with microservices, event-driven design, and messaging queues.

title: Sales Consultant (Request for Proposal)
description:
About the job

Request for Proposal 




Title: Sales Consultant

Issued by: Aloi Private Limited 

Issued Date: 27 January 2026 

Initial Pilot Duration: 1 month (8 hours total) with potential scale-up 

Extended Engagement (if scaled): Up to 20 days per year 

Application Deadline: 6th February 2026 (Friday)




1. Background 




Aloi Private Limited works to enable inclusive access to finance and digital solutions across value chains in Nepal, with a strong focus on agriculture and dairy cooperatives. Through its digital platform and partnerships with financial institutions, Aloi supports dairy cooperatives and farmers to improve access to credit, strengthen operations, and enhance long-term sustainability. 




As Aloi deepens its engagement in the dairy value chain, it has identified a critical need to strengthen practical, on-ground sales capability within its internal teams. While strategic advisory support is important, Aloi’s immediate priority is to embed learning through real sales conversations with dairy cooperatives, supported by an experienced professional who can lead from the front and gradually transition into a structured consultant role. 




To address this, Aloi is seeking a consultant who can begin with direct involvement in sales calls and cooperative conversations, while simultaneously coaching the Aloi team to independently lead these engagements over time. 




2. Core Engagement Philosophy 

This assignment is intentionally designed as a sales-led, learn-by-doing engagement, not a traditional desk-based consultancy. 

The consultant is expected to: 

Start with hands-on sales involvement, including making or leading calls with dairy cooperatives 
Use live conversations as training moments for Aloi’s sales and field teams 
Gradually shift from being the primary caller to a guiding and mentoring role, enabling Aloi’s team to confidently lead discussions 
Package strategic guidance together with warm introductions, real negotiations, and practical follow-ups 




The focus is on how conversations are led, how value is articulated, and how trust with cooperatives is built and sustained. 




3. Scope of Work 

The scope is divided into two linked phases: an initial 1-month intensive pilot and a potential extended engagement based on performance and fit. 




3.1 Phase 1: Sales-Led Pilot Engagement (1 Month | 8 Hours Total) 

During the pilot month, the consultant will work closely with Aloi’s sales and product teams using a structured weekly format: 

Weekly Time Commitment (Approx. 2 hours per week): 

1 hour per week – Team Coaching & Review Call 
Review recent sales conversations and cooperative feedback 
Break down what worked, what did not, and why 
Improve pitching structure, confidence, and objection handling 
Prepare for upcoming cooperative calls 
1 hour per week – Live Cooperative Sales Calls (any of the following formats): 
Consultant leads calls directly with dairy cooperatives, with Aloi team observing 
Consultant makes calls jointly with Aloi team members 
Consultant facilitates calls while Aloi team members lead, with live guidance and post-call feedback 

The intent is to ensure that Aloi’s team learns by watching, participating, and gradually leading. 




At the end of the pilot month, Aloi and the consultant will jointly review: 

Team readiness and confidence improvement 
Effectiveness of the live-call learning approach 
Fit for scaling the engagement into a longer-term advisory role 




3.2 Phase 2: Transition to Structured Consultant Role 

If the pilot engagement is successful, the consultant’s role will gradually shift from direct sales execution to a more structured advisory and capacity-building role, while still retaining selective involvement in strategic conversations. 




Key areas include: 

a) Refinement of Sales Pitch and Engagement Framework 

Translate learnings from live calls into: 
Clear pitching flows 
Objection-handling guides 
Cooperative-specific value narratives 
Develop differentiated approaches for: 
Small vs. mature dairy cooperatives 
Individual cooperatives vs. clusters, unions, or federations 




b) Team Capacity Building 

Coach Aloi’s sales and field teams to independently: 
Lead cooperative conversations 
Manage follow-ups and next steps 
Maintain long-term cooperative relationships 
Support the development of simple playbooks and call structures 




c) Strategic Advisory & Warm Introductions 

Provide warm introductions to relevant cooperatives or sector actors, where feasible 
Advise Aloi on positioning, sequencing of outreach, and engagement strategy 
Support internal reflection on which cooperative segments to prioritise 




4. Key Deliverables 

Expected deliverables across the engagement include: 

Live, hands-on sales calls conducted with or in front of Aloi’s team 
Improved confidence and structure in Aloi team-led cooperative conversations 
Practical call scripts, pitch flows, and objection-handling notes 
Coaching sessions with clear, actionable feedback 
Short notes capturing learnings from sales conversations 
Recommendations on transitioning from supported to independent sales engagement 




5. Duration and Level of Effort 

Pilot Phase: 1 month, approximately 8 hours total 
If Extended: Up to 20 days per year 
Modality: Primarily remote calls, with selective in-person engagement if required 




6. Consultant Profile and Qualifications 

The consultant should have: 

Strong hands-on experience in selling to or engaging dairy cooperatives in Nepal 
Deep understanding of cooperative decision-making dynamics 
Proven ability to lead sales conversations, not just advise on them 
Experience coaching teams through live, practical engagement 
Comfort operating in ambiguous, early-stage sales environments 
Ability to transition from executor to mentor as team capacity improves 




7. Proposal Submission Requirements 

Interested consultants are requested to submit: 

A short technical proposal covering: 
Understanding of the sales-led engagement model 
Proposed approach for the 1-month pilot 
Relevant hands-on sales experience 
A financial proposal (hourly or daily rate) 
Updated CV highlighting relevant assignments 




8. Evaluation Criteria 

Proposals will be evaluated based on: 

Demonstrated hands-on sales experience with cooperatives 
Practicality of the proposed learning-by-doing approach 
Ability to coach while executing 
Clarity on transitioning from direct sales to advisory role 
Cost-effectiveness and availability 




9. Reporting and Coordination 

The consultant will work closely with Aloi’s designated focal person and relevant internal teams. Weekly check-ins will be used to review calls, progress, and learning outcomes, especially during the pilot phase. 




Interested individuals can send us their proposal and CV at careers@aloi.global by 6th February 2026.

title: Work From Home | Video Recording Job | No Experience Required
description:
About the job

Job Type: Part-Time or Full-Time (Freelance)

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

Pay: $6 per hour (Fixed hourly rate)




Job Summary

We are looking for experts to record short videos of everyday home activities.

These videos will be used to help robotics learn how people do normal tasks at home. You will record yourself doing things you already do in your daily life, such as cleaning, laundry, or cooking.




What You Will Do

Record videos of normal daily home activities
Examples include:
Washing dishes (by hand or dishwasher)
Doing laundry
Folding clothes
Sweeping or mopping floors
Making food or coffee
etc
Wear a phone on a headband so your hands are free
Follow simple instructions for how to record
Keep the recording area clean and well lit




What You Need

A smartphone with a wide camera (0.5 zoom)
A headband to hold the phone while recording
A clean and tidy space in your home
Good lighting (natural or indoor light is fine)
Internet connection to upload videos




Important Notes

You do not need acting skills
You do not need to talk during the videos unless asked
You do not need to show your face in the videos
You just do the tasks the normally

Who Can Apply

Anyone who can do basic home tasks
No degree or special skills required
Suitable for people of all backgrounds




Why This Job Matters

Your videos will help improve future technology by showing how real people move and work at home. Every recording helps make robotics technology better and more accurate.

The Opportunity

The Assistant Administration and Facility Manager at Hitachi, Ltd. will support the efficient operation of the facility and administrative functions, ensuring a productive and safe work environment. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety, integrity and quality, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Facilities Management, or a related field.
More than 2 years of experience in an administrative support or facilities management role, preferably within a corporate environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
Experience with vendor management and negotiation is a plus. Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team setting. Knowledge of health and safety regulations relevant to office environments is desirable.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader in electrification, powering a sustainable energy future through innovative power grid technologies with digital at the core. Over three billion people depend on our technologies to power their daily lives.

With over a century in pioneering mission-critical technologies like high-voltage, transformers, automation, and power electronics, we are addressing the most urgent energy challenge of our time – balancing soaring electricity demand, while decarbonizing the power system.

Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 50,000 people in 60 countries and generate revenues of around $16 billion USD. We welcome you to apply today.

This role is responsible for conducting detailed requirements analysis, developing Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), and translating complex business processes into structured user stories, use cases, process flows, and wireframes.

• Engage with stakeholders, clients, and users to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

• Proficiency with requirements management and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).

• Familiarity with SQL for data analysis and validation.

• Familiarity with APIs, web services, and systems integration concepts.

title: Legal Specialist
description:
About the job

Organizational Setting

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production, better nutrition, a better environment and a better life, leaving no one behind.

FAO is a specialized agency of the UN that leads international efforts to defeat hunger. FAO's goal is to achieve food security for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high-quality food to lead active, healthy lives. With 195 Members (194 countries and the European Union), FAO works in over 130 countries worldwide.

FAO Country Offices, working under overall corporate guidance and in line with the Strategic Framework, offer policy advice and support to countries in the mandated areas of FAO, facilitated through partnerships, resources and an active country programme to provide technical assistance, develop capacities and deliver core services while fully observing international standards of accountability to establish leadership and strengthen impact at the country level.

The offices deliver on the programmatic priorities of each country as agreed in their respective Country Programming Frameworks (CPFs) aligned to the UN Sustainable Development Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) and ensure effective and efficient operations with adequate human and financial resources.

Specifically, FAO Country Offices

(i) advocate, inform and support policies and investments in the areas of FAO’s mandate.

(ii) provide technical assistance and deliver core services.

(iii) assist and catalyse partnership and resource mobilization activities to support agrifood systems transformation.

(iv) position FAO as the specialized/authoritative technical agency in food and agriculture and agrifood systems transformation.

(v) ensure risk-smart and accountable operations and management.

The Sustainable Wildlife Management (SWM) Programme is an ambitious and innovative multi-year initiative, which began in 2017 and is funded by the European Union with co-funding from the French Facility for Global Environment (FFEM) and the French Development Agency (AFD). The initiative is implemented through a partnership led by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), with the Centre for International Forestry Research and World Agroforestry (CIFOR-ICRAF), the French Agricultural Research Centre for International Development (CIRAD), and the Wildlife Conservation Society (WCS).

In 2024, the SWM Programme expanded its presence in the Asia-Pacific (AP) region, which had previously only included Papua New Guinea. The region’s exceptional biodiversity, coupled with rising population pressure, habitat degradation, and wildlife trade, including demand for wild meat, makes it a hotspot for zoonotic disease emergence. The SWM AP Project (2024–26) addresses these challenges by launching activities in countries with a history of rural wild meat consumption and zoonotic risk. The project identifies gaps and proposes targeted interventions. In addition to Nepal, the SWM Programme has recently extended its operations to Vietnam and Lao PDR.

In Nepal, the SWM Programme aims to strengthen policy and legal frameworks for sustainable wildlife management and related agri-food systems. To achieve this, it will assess the existing legal and institutional frameworks around key sectors relevant to the sustainable management of wildlife and related agrifood systems in Nepal. To frame this analysis, the SWM Programme has developed diagnostic tools on 18 policy areas: tenure systems, wildlife management, hunting, wildlife tourism, inland fisheries, timber forest products, terrestrial animal production, aquaculture, veterinary medical products, animal feed, pesticides, management of ecosystems and habitats, non-timber forest products, waste management, animal health, animal welfare, food safety and genetic resources. This process includes conducting a legal analysis of priority sectors identified by the government and making them available to the public through the SWM Legal Hub. The analysis will highlight strengths and weaknesses of the applicable legal framework and provide actionable recommendations for legal reform and improvement.

Reporting Lines

Under the overall supervision of the FAO Representative (FAOR) in Nepal, the Legal Specialist will report to one or more professional staff and receives guidance from Legal Officer from FAO Headquarter. He/she acts independently in routine matters. Supervision received is focused on the quality of the work performed and provides for on-the-job learning.

Technical Focus

The incumbent plays a lead role in the overall provision of the implementation of SWM project. He/ she plays a lead role in the provision of technical support services for successful achievement of the organizational unit's mandate.

Tasks And Responsibilities


 Support the preparation of a stakeholder map to help organize and lead a multi-stakeholder meeting/workshop with key stakeholders involved in sustainable wildlife management and related agri-food systems (from wildlife management and harvesting to animal production and food safety) in Nepal.
 Support in shaping agenda and discussing legal components and objectives of the legal analysis and help document key discussion points in the multistakeholder meeting. Based on this, the Legal Specialist assists in drafting a roadmap to inform future participatory reform processes.
 Conduct a desk review of existing studies/analyses on the national legal and institutional framework carried out over the last 10 years related to the identified focus areas of the legal analysis. The Legal specialist helps identify appropriate documents and policy papers by supporting desk research.
 Assist in coordinating and exchanging information with key stakeholders by supporting the organization of bilateral meetings and documenting contextual details and analysis.
 Identify and collect existing policies and corresponding legislation/regulations across the sectors relevant to the sustainable management of wildlife and related areas.
 Based on the overall methodology provided by the SWM Legal team, fill up the data entry backend using the relevant Legal Diagnostic Tools consisting of a list of thematic questions, and further develop per each of them brief “summaries” on the enabling legal and regulatory framework for sustainable wildlife management.
 Support the organization and facilitation of a validation workshop with relevant stakeholders, notably from line ministries and key stakeholders involved under Activity 3 above, to review and validate the results of the legal analysis prior to their publication on the SWM Legal Hub.
 Support and facilitate discussions with government partners on the need/wish for future policy reform processes and FAO’s proposed role.
 Conduct a desk review of studies and analyses on customary norms and practices for sustainable wildlife management in Nepal. Support in organizing the validation workshops and validation of the findings through regular consultations and bilateral meetings.
 Support the documentation of evidence of the successful integration of customary practices into the legal framework and the drafting of a structured analytical note.
 Draft a structured analytical note (10–15 pages) summarizing findings, including: Overview of customary norms; Case studies or examples from Nepal; Recommendations for strengthening these practices within the legal framework.


CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements


 A Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Wildlife Management, Conservation Biology, Natural Resource Management, Fisheries and Wildlife Sciences or Ecology.
 A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in wildlife management, conservation biology or natural resource management. (Master’s Degree with 5 years’ experience can also be considered).

title: Sponsorship Assistant - Kanchanpur with verification
description:
About the job

With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 33,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children’s life stories!

Key Responsibilities

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

The Sponsorship Assistant provides support for the implementation of Sponsorship Business Operations within the AP. The Sponsorship Officer works closely with the AP team, partner organization, field mobilisers and community-based committees to ensure well-being of sponsored and non-sponsored children are in place and the organizational requirements related to Sponsorship operations are met according to Sponsorship standards and policies. This position will support to apply Sponsorship in Programming principles to ensure Sponsorship operations and processes integrate with the programme and community efforts: i) to care for and protect children; and ii) to strengthen children’s participation, so the registered children participate and benefit from programme activities.

All Sponsorship Systems are operated and updated efficiently


Ensure timely data entry in Horizon Systems regularly
Ensure data quality, validation, consolidation and qualification for Auto-APR process
Ensure all Horizon Hope mobile devices are synced regularly
Maintain management of mobile device as per guideline (MDM – MaaS360) in coordination with local IT
Ensure quality checking of all Annual Rich Media contents, provide translations and upload to the system
Generate and send all system related report to Supervisor
Reconcile number of RC and mitigate all discrepancies
Provide incoming gifts and correspondences to SFM and guide them for Child reply, along with CCF
Provide correctly translated child reply to letters for FO/NO review and processing
Provide contextual and accurate responses to queries on time
Ensure backup for smooth function in Systems
Ensure solution of any problems in the system
Tracking and monitoring standard time for services. Clear my Task meeting all requirements
Keep in constant contact with FO: Data Coordinator & Correspondence Coordinators


Sponsorship Management


Sponsorship KPI reporting: Facilitate Child Sponsorship reporting to ensure well-being of Registered Children and manage quality of Child Sponsorship, such as periodical CMS, SOI, Death reports are on time throughout the year with Green ratings (Horizon HOPE), if discrepancies facilitate for review, analysis, tracking and follow-up at AP level (analyse, reconcile AP Performance status, identify emerging issues and engage stakeholders).
RC Portfolio: Engage with Partner NGO team to manage RC Portfolio (+-2%) to ensure RC supply for Support Offices is always within standard including creating new child records and reactivation of holds.
RC Data Management: RC records and files are well managed, scanned and stored securely. Conduct RC Data review in Horizon Hope for accuracy to ensure all data points of new and existing RC are correctly reported in Hope. Follow the correct process for RC Data correction. Review RC ID list to ensure no Duplicates Child IDs generated in the system.
Child selection: The development of child selection criteria for Child Sponsorship, community participation in selection processes and mandated documentation is complete.
CMS: Support child monitoring processes to ensure children are monitored according to Child Monitoring Standards, under locally agreed timelines.
Case management and follow-up: Ensure Horizon Child-Wellbeing data (Case Management) is regularly reviewed and updated. Ensure reporting and follow-up adherence to organizational protocols. Timely and accurate reporting of Child Death and Emergency cases must be ensured.
Programme links: Provide analysis, interpretation of CMS, Child-Wellbeing and child participation data with AP team for appropriate case management follow-through and action. Utilize the reporting and referral mechanism


Sponsor And Child Engagement


Nurture sponsor and child connections: Facilitate quality and timely communication between sponsors and Registered Children.
Manage Sponsorship activities to contribute to Child Participation, Life Skills and Voice: Ensure sponsor engagement feature opportunities contribute to developing life skills and promoting child participation and voice. Support implementation of sponsor communication through IPF activities as per activity designs.
Efficient management & delivery of sponsor engagement features: Facilitate practices and appropriate tools to ensure management of sponsor child communications (IL, SL, GN, EL, SAC, APR, CEW, SG, QMS, FL, BB and Rich Media content and sponsor queries), within Sponsorship standards.
Digital and Non-digital Correspondence: Ensure sponsor gifts/letters are well received from respective FO/ WV National Office (NO), verify the CCF and acknowledge the shipment. Facilitate in the processing of all incoming and outgoing special mails; Sponsors Seasonal Greetings cards, Bulk cards with activity packs, Spontaneous letters, SO/Sponsor Queries Letters within standard timeline. Facilitate translation of correspondence to ensure accuracy and emotional nuance is communicated to children and to sponsors. Send all Reply letters (IL, EL, RL and GAL) to Field Office after content and translation review.
Rich Media Quality review: Quality review of Rich Media (CGP, CGV, CUP, CUV, YUP, YUV) products. (New SI Field Content for SFP APs)
CEW: Support field mobilizers to complete 100% of Child Expression Worksheets (CEW) with meaningful child engagement and quality, for timely delivery. Ensure all CEW are tagged to the correct Child ID in Horizon Hope.
Sponsorship 3.0: Facilitate Sponsorship 3.0 initiatives in the Area Programmes to ensure simple, modern and digital management of Sponsorship experience for all.
Production and delivery of materials: Support coordination of design, development of communication materials, quality assurance and administration.
Sponsor visits: Support DC to plan and facilitate sponsor visits, and ensure the visiting sponsors are well attended on and get wide exposure and positive impression from visit, with adherence of required protocols, such as production of the Sponsor Visit Report, Sponsor Visit CUP, Sponsor Visit-Thank you Letter.
Capture transformational stories: Ensure Quality Communication that captures Transformational Stories to communicate with sponsors. Support the capture, document and share lessons, good practices, innovations, impact stories, photos and videos for other stakeholders.


Capacity Building


Sponsorship capacity building: Support District Coordinator to facilitate capacity building trainings on Sponsorship standards, emerging practices in child participation, child engagement, SOI, CMS, Correspondence, Rich Media, Horizon Hope business processes, Sponsorship 3.0 initiatives, policies and Sponsorship initiatives to staff, children, community volunteers and partners - follow up its implementation and application. Enable staff of partner organization(s) to establish strong relationship with and mechanism to support children and families for active participation and engagement in integrated programmes and Sponsorship. 
Capacity Gaps: Support District Coordinators to identify capacity gaps at Area Programme level and community and use the most appropriate training approach to address.
Horizon Hope Mobile App training: Ensure capacity building to frontliners on Horizon Hope Mobile App use to monitor RC. Provide orientation to new Sponsorship Field Mobilisers on relevant Horizon features and Basics of Sponsorship and its business process
Equip Sponsorship Field Mobilisers (SFM) and CWB monitoring committees: To inspire, equip and manage SFM and CWB monitoring committees as active agents of change for children with the required skills to meet Child Sponsorship requirements and to be emotionally available for children to contribute positively to their lives. Ensure appropriate training for emerging child and adolescent leaders.


Quality Assurance And Risk Management


Child protection standards: Facilitate to ensure Sponsorship data management, quality and practices are aligned to Sponsorship and child protection policies, standards and procedures. Maintain updated child information in the system and ensure data protection and Horizon Privacy Policy, as per WV Guidelines.
Awareness: Facilitate awareness of community, sponsors, registered children and AP staff on Child Sponsorship protocols and standards. 
Risk management: Support in identification and mitigation of all risk exposures at AP level according to the latest Sponsorship Feasibility and Risk Assessment, and other accountability review processes to manage implementation.
Management of internal and external relationships required in Sponsorship operations that facilitate the satisfaction of children, families, communities, and sponsors/donors.
Good coordination and collaboration with FO finance, SCM, and courier for smooth and quick service.


Required Professional Experience


Minimum of 2-year experience in similar or equivalent positions in development sector or Sponsorship-focused organization
Experience in preparing and facilitating training workshops
Experience working in a rural or remote district of Nepal
In depth understanding and experience in Child Sponsorship and its contribution to child wellbeing
Area program work experience in Sponsorship or development projects
Demonstrated competencies in operational aspects of Child Sponsorship
Demonstrated facilitation skills, including cascading, connecting, and capacity building


Required Education, Training, License, Registration And Certification


Bachelor’s degree in social science/development studies/ Sociology/ International Relation or any relevant field
Excellent presentation and communication skills


Preferred Knowledge And Qualifications


Knowledge of Sponsorship approach, systems and processes
Knowledge and practical skills in working with children with basic understanding of Child Protection and Advocacy
Knowledge of community development and engagement
Knowledge of local partnering
Effective written and oral communications skills including presentation and reporting skills
Good interpersonal skills and cross-cultural sensitivity. Strong collaboration and partnership skills to mobilize engagement and influence
Computer and Technology; Strong computer skills including Word, Excel, PowerPoint; Strong experience in using technology including information management database software and platforms
User experience with WV’s data management, information platforms and Sponsorship systems such as Horizon
Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams.
High level of integrity towards resources, and identifying risks etc.
Strong negotiation, interpersonal skills, organizational, administrative and facilitation skills
Must be able to interact with diverse groups and stakeholders


Travel and/or Work Environment


Will be required to be based in one of WVI NEPAL’s operational district and working from partner NGO’s office
Will be required to spend at least 40% of work time conducting monitoring and field visits in target municipalities and wards
Willingness to work outside office hours especially when conducting monitoring/field visits, when hosting sponsor/donor visits and meeting Sponsorship deadline for key deliverables


Work Base: Kanchanpur, Nepal

Local Applicants Only

description:
About the job

Who we are

Mantle is the entry point for institutions and traditional finance to access real-world assets on-chain. Backed by the world’s largest community-owned treasury of over $4B, Mantle combines institutional-grade infrastructure with the scale and credibility to bring RWAs into Web3 with confidence.

Mantle positions itself as the gateway for institutions and TradFi to move into RWAs on-chain. With $4B+ in community-owned assets, Mantle combines credibility, liquidity and scale with institutional infrastructure to support large-scale adoption. The ecosystem is anchored by $MNT in the Bybit network, and built out through subsidiaries mETH, fBTC, MI4 and MantleX. This is complemented by Mantle Network’s partnerships with leading issuers and protocols such as Agora AUSD, Ethena USDe, Ondo USDY and EigenLayer.

Your Role

As a Partner Success Manager at Mantle, you’ll work at the intersection of product, project management, and business development. You’ll own the end-to-end process for ecosystem product delivery, from ideation to execution, while negotiating deals that expand Mantle’s reach - also termed as success. Your responsibilities will span coordination across internal teams, market research, project management, and hands-on partner engagement.

Responsibilities


Product & Project Ownership: Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of key ecosystem products and initiatives, managing timelines and cross-functional teams.
Partner Engagement: Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with potential partners—including DeFi protocols, centralized exchanges, and competitor chains—to support Mantle’s growth.
Deal Execution: Own end-to-end execution of BD deals from initial outreach/negotiation to onboarding and integration, ensuring smooth delivery.
Market Intelligence: Conduct ongoing research on landscape and top DeFi protocols to identify new opportunities and learnings.
Stakeholder Management: Collaborate across engineering, legal, and marketing to align on requirements, deliverables, and timelines.
Process Improvement: Establish and refine processes for partner integration and project delivery to ensure fast turnaround and high quality.
Reporting: Track progress on partnership integrations and product launches; clearly communicate status and risks to leadership.


Requirements


Proven experience in operations, business development or ecosystem/product management at a chain, centralized exchange, or top DeFi protocol with a reputation for rapid delivery.
Demonstrated ability to handle full-cycle execution: from initial deal structuring/negotiation through to project management and delivery.
Strong organizational skills; able to manage concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication skills for both internal stakeholders and external partners; able to articulate complex technical concepts clearly.
Deep understanding of Ethereum Layer 2 solutions, DeFi protocols, and the Web3 ecosystem.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related field.
Previous experience in Sales/CRM management is a plus.


Personal Attributes


Self-starter with high ownership mentality
Detail-oriented but able to see the bigger picture
Comfortable working in a hybrid (remote + in-person) setup
Strong negotiation skills with proven results

title: 借贷风控专家 with verification
description:
About the job

注：该岗位需要在阿布扎比或马来西亚工作




关于我们

Bybit 成立于 2018 年 3 月，是全球增长最快的加密货币衍生品交易所之一，现已拥有超过 7000 万注册用户。我们为加密货币交易者提供专业平台，配备超高速撮合引擎、优质客户服务以及多语言社区支持。业务涵盖创新型的现货与衍生品交易、挖矿与质押产品，以及 API 接口服务，面向全球零售与机构客户，致力于成为新兴数字资产领域最值得信赖的交易所。




我们的核心价值观塑造了我们。我们倾听用户、关心用户、不断优化，力求为用户打造更快、更公平、更人性化的交易环境。我们的创新型、高度先进、用户友好的平台基于顶级基础设施自研打造，旨在为用户提供业内最安全、最快速、最公平、最透明的交易体验。秉承以客户为中心的理念，我们提供 7x24 小时、多语言专业客服，及时高效地为用户提供支持。




如今，Bybit 已成为业内最值得信赖、最可靠、最透明的加密货币衍生品交易平台之一。




职位概述

作为借贷风控专家，你将负责构建和管理我们借贷业务的全生命周期风险，保护平台和用户的资产安全。你需要设计并实施信用评估模型、监控抵押品风险、优化资金定价，并管理极端市场下的流动性风险，确保借贷业务在安全的前提下稳健增长。




主要职责

风险策略与模型：
负责借款人的信用风险评估，设计和优化适用于加密领域的信用评分卡和风险定价模型。
管理借借贷额度、抵押品折扣率等核心风控参数，制定并优化不同加密资产的抵押率（LTV）和清算线。
建立针对机构客户和高净值客户的尽职调查与授信审批流程。
风险与流动性管理：
监控借贷业务的整体风险敞口，进行资产-负债管理，确保平台的流动性充足。
分析资产组合的集中度风险（如单一资产、单一对手方风险）。
建立压力测试和情景分析框架，评估极端市场条件对借贷业务的影响。
数据分析与系统优化：
深度分析借贷交易数据，识别潜在的风险点和欺诈模式。
与产品和研发团队协作，将风控策略和逻辑落地到业务系统中，实现自动化风险管理。
定期生成风险报告，向管理层汇报业务风险状况、关键指标和改善建议。




任职要求

必备条件：

本科及以上学历，金融工程、数学、统计学、经济学、计算机等相关专业。
至少3年以上 在银行、券商、消费金融公司、互联网金融平台或加密货币交易所/借贷机构 的信用风险、借贷风控相关工作经验。
扎实的金融风险知识，熟悉信用风险计量、抵押品管理、风险定价和流动性风险管理。
具备强大的数据处理和分析能力，必须熟练使用SQL，并掌握Python/R等工具进行数据建模和统计分析。
出色的逻辑思维能力、问题解决能力和沟通能力。

加分项：

对加密货币市场有深刻理解，熟悉各类借贷产品和资产特性
拥有FRM（金融风险管理师）、CFA（特许金融分析师）等专业资格认证。
有构建信用评分模型或风险定价模型的实际项目经验。







为什么加入我们

在 Bybit，我们致力于营造一个支持性强、充满成长机会的工作环境。

我们的福利包括：

学习成长基金：支持你的专业发展与持续学习。
内部活动：定期举办团队建设、工作坊及活动，促进协作与创新。
全球协作：与来自世界各地的多元化国际团队紧密合作。
职业发展：在高速扩张的全球化公司中，获得广阔的成长与晋升机会。
内部流动：与公司共同成长。我们重视你的长期发展，并提供内部岗位流动机会，助力你的职业路径规划。

title: Senior Flutter Engineer (Real-Time Systems & Delivery)
description:
About the job

Project: NepoLive Mobile

Engagement: Fixed-Scope / Milestone-Based Contract

Work Mode: Hybrid / Remote

Compensation: Milestone-based; Performance & Delivery tethered

Start: Immediate




THE MISSION

NepoLive requires an expert Flutter Developer to finalize and polish our mobile applications. We are not looking for a "UI coder"—we need an Engineer who understands the underlying plumbing of mobile operating systems. Your primary objective is to ensure a unified, high-performance experience on both iOS and Android using a single codebase.




CORE DELIVERABLES

Dual-Platform Parity: Execute features that perform flawlessly on both OSs. Whether it requires Method Channels or clever Dart implementation, the "it works on my Android but not their iPhone" excuse is not an option.
Real-Time Architecture: Own the implementation of WebRTC and WebSockets for low-latency communication features.
Production Hardening: Take the existing Flutter project from its current state to "Store Ready." This includes handling permissions, background tasks, and OS-specific push notification configurations.
Native Troubleshooting: While you work in Flutter, you must have the competence to debug Gradle issues on Android or CocoaPods/Xcode build errors on iOS without external help.




TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT STACK

Framework: 4+ years of professional experience with Flutter & Dart.
Protocols: Deep practical experience with WebRTC (signalling, STUN/TURN) and persistent WebSocket connections.
Platform Knowledge: Proven track record of deploying at least 2+ complex apps to both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
State Management: Mastery of Provider, Bloc, or Riverpod (consistency is key).
OS Logic: Understanding of mobile lifecycles, local storage (SQLite/Hive), and battery-efficient background processing.




PERFORMANCE STANDARD (THE "NO BLUFF" POLICY)

Ownership of the "Final Inch": You are responsible for the app actually running on physical devices, not just the emulator.
Zero Hand-holding: You will be provided with the Figma files, API documentation, and the current repo. You are expected to bridge the gaps independently.
Accountability: We pay for verified milestones. If a feature is "finished" but fails on one of the two major OSs, the milestone is not complete.




WORK POLICY

Delivery Over Presence: We do not track your hours; we track your pull requests and milestone completions.
Strict Deadlines: This is a delivery contract. Missing a milestone without prior, valid technical justification will result in contract review.
Clean Code: Code must be maintainable. Future developers should not have to "rescue" your work.




HOW TO APPLY :-

Email hr@bichitras.com with your portfolio/resume and a direct response to these three points:

Links to at least one app you’ve personally published on both iOS and Android.
Your specific experience implementing WebRTC in a Flutter environment.
How you handle OS-specific bugs that only appear in production builds.

 

Subject Line (Mandatory): EXPFLUT-CONTRACT 

Note: We filter strictly by subject line. Failure to follow this instruction is viewed as a lack of attention to detail.

title: Senior Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Advisor
description:
About the job

Position: Senior Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Advisor

The Senior Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) Advisor provides technical guidance on all MEL aspects of the Strengthening Infectious disease Detection Systems (STRIDES) Activity in Nepal, including overseeing the execution of day-to-day MEL activities, and ensuring quality service delivery using project data to ensure evidence-based decision-making. S/he will lead activities to develop, operationalize, implement, and manage MEL systems, tools, and procedures to collect, collate, analyze, interpret, and use data that demonstrates impact and Activity accountability and progress.

Key Responsibilities


Supports design, development, planning, implementation of, and reporting against STRIDES Activity Monitoring, Evaluation, & Learning Plan (AMELP). 
Develops, operationalizes, implements, and manages MEL systems, tools, and procedures to collect, collate, analyze, interpret, and use data that demonstrate impact and Activity accountability and progress. 
Tracks STRIDES progress against MEL indicators and targets to ensure consistent and systematic tracking and reporting. 
Ensures that relevant MEL plans integrate high-quality quantitative and qualitative methods and participatory methodologies to monitor project quality for performance and results. 
Assesses subcontractors MEL-related data and reporting efforts to verify quality. 
Builds STRIDES staff MEL capacity, including strengthening, managing and operationalizing MEL systems, data quality assurance, data demand and use, facilitating learning and knowledge exchange, documenting lessons learned and best practices, and reporting. 
Leads STRIDES learning activities and data use initiative; fosters culture of learning and knowledge sharing. 
Manages in-country relationships with national, regional, and local government counterparts and multisectoral partners in the MEL space; identifies technical support needed to fulfill national global health security and MEL objectives. 
Leads the development of country-specific MEL plans and budgets aligned with STRIDES goals and ensuring compliance with donor and organizational policies and procedures. 
Supervises and mentors MEL team member staff and supports performance management and professional development of direct reports, including ongoing feedback, coaching, and career support. 
Provide technical leadership in design, planning, implementation, and monitoring of research, surveillance and surveys, data analysis, data visualization, dashboard and report preparation, and dissemination of surveillance in humans, animals, and communities. 
Lead and coordinate to develop framework to identify integrated data analysis and sharing across human health, animal health, environment and food sectors. 
Provide technical assistance in the preparation and submission of AMR/AMU-related data and reports in accordance with national, regional and global standards and requirements including annual reports to Global Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance System and World Animal Health Organization. 
Provide technical assistance to National Public Health Laboratory, Central Veterinary Laboratory and AMR/AMU/AMC surveillance sites to collect, refine, analyse, visualize, and use the AMR/AMU/AMC surveillance data. 
Review, synthesize, and summarize the findings of AMR/AMU/AMC surveillance and research findings and recommendations with impression and implication for national AMR/AMU/AMC program as well as FFCGN phase 2 and share with AMRMSC, NTWC, sectoral technical working groups and FFCGN staff on a quarterly and annual basis. 
Lead, coordinate, and support the design, development and implementation of research-, surveillance-, and monitoring-related trainings and workshops at the national and site levels. 
Provide technical support and guidance to the project team on research-, surveillance- and monitoring-related activities. 
Provide backstopping support and technical assistance to FFCGN phase 2 implementing partners for research and surveillance-related activities. 
Contribute to FHI 360 Nepal’s overall SI framework and approach as a member of the Nepal SI forum/team. 
Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director and/or Country Representative. 


Requirements


Master’s degree in public health or other relevant subjects and five years of experience or a bachelor’s degree in public health or other relevant subject and seven years of experience in managing and conducting epidemiological and/or social science research and surveillance in public health. 
Experience in standard epidemiological and statistical methods/tools and with quantitative and qualitative research methods and surveillance. 
Knowledge and experience of global health security (GHS) including laboratory and antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance, and disease surveillance and other relevant health programs. 
Proficient in statistical software packages (SAS/Stata/SPSS), WHONET and other bridging software. 
Experience in translating data sets into easily accessible and useful information that supports the achievement of program objectives (e.g., using maps, dashboards, and visualization tools). 
Experience in working effectively across various teams within the project and organization and building and sustaining positive working relationships with non-government organizations, private sectors, government and other stakeholders. 
Proactive in managing multiple tasks, managing and working in virtual work environment, and flexible and open for managing time for working with different teams in different time zones as needed. 
Excellent interpersonal, organizational, communication, team building and management, and problem-solving skills. 
Excellent oral and written English and Nepali including documentation skills. 


Applications are limited to Nepali citizens who meet the eligibility criteria.

Final deadline for application is January 29, 2026.

Evaluate AI-generated responses to healthcare-related queries for accuracy, clarity, reasoning, and completeness
Verify all medical claims using trusted public sources and authoritative references
Annotate and score model outputs by identifying strengths, weaknesses, and factual or clinical inaccuracies
Assess tone, appropriateness, and completeness of responses for real-world healthcare communication
Ensure all outputs align with defined system guidelines and conversational standards
Apply standardized evaluation frameworks, taxonomies, and benchmarks consistently

Expertise in one or more of the following areas:
General clinical care
Specialty medicine or surgery
Diagnostics, imaging, or laboratory medicine
Public health, healthcare systems, or healthcare administration
Strong familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and how they are used in practice
Excellent written communication skills for complex medical topics
Exceptional attention to detail and ability to detect subtle clinical or factual errors




Preferred Qualifications

Experience with RLHF, AI evaluation, or data annotation
Background in medical writing, editing, or clinical documentation
